title: Hares in the Barley
description: Cinder hares are trampling the barley terraces. Cull five of them for Elder Maren.

title: Boar Trouble
description: With the hares thinned, mossback boars grow bold. Drive off three of them.

title: Lights in the Fen
description: Fen wisps lure travelers off the paths. Quench four of them before someone follows a light and never returns.

title: A Murder of Crows
description: Hollow crows strip the drying racks. Scatter six of the thieves for the granary's sake.

title: Teeth on the Old Road
description: Rustjaw wolves den along the old road where my scavengers walk. Pell will pay in tonics for two pelts' worth of proof.

title: Boars in the Barley
description: The mossbacks are back and bolder, rooting up whole terraces. Pell's buyers still pay for hide — bring five down.

title: Quench the Marshlights
description: The wisps gather thicker where the fen meets the fields. Maren asks for five more quenched lights.

title: The Pack Grows Bold
description: Wolves at the palisade now, not just the road. Three of them, warden, before they learn the taste of barley-fed stock.

title: Hares Again
description: Culls never hold with hares. Pell's stewpots are empty and the terraces crawl again — eight this time.

title: The Rustjaw Alpha
description: One great rustjaw leads the pack, scarred and cunning. End the alpha and Ironhold breathes easy — the council will remember this.

title: Paws on the Ridge
description: Fen hounds den along the ridge trail. Drive off four of them for Warden Sella.

title: Boars of the Crag
description: Crag boars root up the signal cairns. Scatter three of them.

title: Sparks Above
description: Ember wisps drift down from the high scars and spook the herds. Quench four.

title: Crows on the Wind
description: Cliff crows steal the beacon cords. Bring down six.

title: The Fenmarch Alpha
description: The alpha hound dens above the camp. End it, and Fenmarch breathes easy.
